intro: Tatternack Steelforge is an orc smith stationed out in the harsh savanna of the Barrens, offering work to travelers who can handle raw metal and dangerous frontier fauna. Adept in the ways of iron and fire, he looks to study local ores and arm Horde forces against threats across the plains.

p: In the arid sprawl of the Barrens, keeping Horde outposts armed is no small task. Tatternack Steelforge brings the traditional metalworking expertise of his people to the frontier, seeking both practical weapons and unusual geological specimens to bolster the Horde's foothold against wild beasts, centaur raiders, and hostile quilboar.
